content_audit_events_actor_staff_require.name: content_audit_events_actor_staff_required
content_audit_events_actor_staff_require.value:
(
        ("content_audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'STAFF' AND "content_audit_events"."actor_staff_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("content_audit_events"."actor_kind" = 'SYSTEM' AND "content_audit_events"."actor_staff_user_id" IS NULL)
      )

content_items_schedule_pair.name: content_items_schedule_pair
content_items_schedule_pair.value:
(
        ("content_items"."scheduled_version_id" IS NULL AND "content_items"."scheduled_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("content_items"."scheduled_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "content_items"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

content_items_published_draft_pointers_d.name: content_items_published_draft_pointers_distinct
content_items_published_draft_pointers_d.value:
"content_items"."published_version_id" IS NULL
        OR "content_items"."draft_version_id" IS NULL
        OR "content_items"."published_version_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "content_items"."draft_version_id"

content_items_published_scheduled_pointe.name: content_items_published_scheduled_pointers_distinct
content_items_published_scheduled_pointe.value:
"content_items"."published_version_id" IS NULL
        OR "content_items"."scheduled_version_id" IS NULL
        OR "content_items"."published_version_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "content_items"."scheduled_version_id"

content_items_draft_scheduled_pointers_d.name: content_items_draft_scheduled_pointers_distinct
content_items_draft_scheduled_pointers_d.value:
"content_items"."draft_version_id" IS NULL
        OR "content_items"."scheduled_version_id" IS NULL
        OR "content_items"."draft_version_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "content_items"."scheduled_version_id"

content_items_published_state_coherent.name: content_items_published_state_coherent
content_items_published_state_coherent.value:
"content_items"."publication_status" <> 'PUBLISHED'
        OR (
          "content_items"."published_version_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "content_items"."published_at" IS NOT NULL
        )

content_review_events_note_bounds.name: content_review_events_note_bounds
content_review_events_note_bounds.value:
(
        ("content_review_events"."event_type" = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' AND "content_review_events"."note" IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length("content_review_events"."note") BETWEEN 3 AND 4000)
        OR
        ("content_review_events"."event_type" <> 'CHANGES_REQUESTED' AND (
          "content_review_events"."note" IS NULL
          OR char_length("content_review_events"."note") BETWEEN 3 AND 4000
        ))
      )

staff_users_email_canonical.name: staff_users_email_canonical
staff_users_email_canonical.value: "staff_users"."email" = lower("staff_users"."email") AND "staff_users"."email" = btrim("staff_users"."email") AND char_length("staff_users"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 254
